Here’s what typically happens once you hit “Start”:

| Step | What Happens |
|------|--------------|
| **Ignition** | Engine turns over, sensors power up. |
| **Diagnostics** | ECU reads sensor values – fuel gauge, voltage regulator, alternator output, etc. |
| **Display Update** | Dashboard gauges refresh automatically. |

If you’d like to confirm those readings manually through our API, you can request them right after starting the engine:

```python
# Start the engine
response_start = startEngine(ignitionMode="START")

# Check fuel level
fuel_info = displayCarStatus(option="fuel")   # returns current fuel percentage / liters

# Check battery status
battery_info = displayCarStatus(option="battery")  # returns voltage & charge level
```

So feel free to give the key a turn—you’ll see both the fuel gauge and battery indicator update instantly. If anything looks off, let me know and we can troubleshoot further!
